evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.01→3.36 Torr over k=21..25 while Ar flow and T are at setpoint
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow increase
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44-45%, thermal control nominal
Sensor not installed; atmosphere purity/leak status cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or leak-up/pump-down test: close inlet and watch P) to distinguish a downstream exhaust restriction from an air leak; also valve position/pump status telemetry.
